cc:Work.dc:title: A yes/no question tree
cc:Work.dc:description: Ask Is it A? Yes identifies A, probability one half. If no, ask Is it B? Yes identifies B and no identifies C, each with probability one quarter. The outcomes need one, two and two questions, respectively.
